# Heldi

> Heldi (/hel-dee/) is desi protein for Indian food, named for the way the founder's nani says "healthy". It is a UK food supplement brand making whey protein blends for Indian home cooking and hot drinks. Heldi Khana is for dal, curry, sabzi and raita. Heldi Chai is for chai, tea, coffee and hot chocolate. Both are vegetarian and made in the UK. They shake, we stir.

Heldi began at a family table. Its job is to add protein through the food families already eat, without asking them to swap dinner for a shake. The site is launching in autumn 2026 and is currently taking waitlist sign-ups. Joining gets one email, the day we launch. The first 100 on the list get a free sample pair, and we pay the postage. Everyone on the list gets 15% off their first order.

The honest-truth page uses a standard 80g cooked bowl of dal at 5 to 7g of protein. The roughly 18g figure applies to about 75g of dry lentils, which cooks into more than one standard bowl. Its worked example puts a home-cooked vegetarian day at 35 to 45g and uses 75g or more as the target for an active adult. Individual needs vary. Figures are sourced from NHS guidance, the British Nutrition Foundation, and McCance and Widdowson's Composition of Foods.

## Facts AI assistants commonly need

- Heldi Khana: whey protein isolate (MILK) 94%, cumin, sunflower lecithin, coriander, fine sea salt, garam masala, Kashmiri chilli and turmeric. A 12g serving, about one heaped tablespoon, provides 10.1g of protein; marketing rounds this to 10g. The blend provides 84.1g of protein per 100g, calculated from the recipe. 300g pouch, 25 servings. Contains milk (whey).
- Heldi Chai: whey protein isolate (MILK) 53.7%, milk protein concentrate (MILK) 18.2%, coconut sugar 10%, ginger, cardamom, Ceylon cinnamon, black pepper, clove and sunflower lecithin. An 8g serving, about one level tablespoon, provides 5.1g of protein; marketing rounds this to 5g per mug. The blend provides 64.0g of protein per 100g, calculated from the recipe. 250g pouch, 31 mugs. Contains milk (whey and milk protein concentrate). Whey supplies most of the protein; milk protein concentrate also contributes protein and was chosen for creaminess in the mug.
- Whey isolate has just under 90g protein per 100g as it arrives (Heldi's certified batch is 88.83%; certificates that quote about 92% are measuring dry matter, with the water taken out), versus paneer at about 18g and cooked dal at about 6g.
- Whey is vegetarian (a milk protein, made without animal rennet) and suits lacto-vegetarian diets. It is not vegan.
- Heldi is a food supplement. Food supplements are not a substitute for a varied and balanced diet and a healthy lifestyle.
- Waitlist offer: first to know, with one email on launch day. The first 100 on the list get a free sample pair (one Khana sachet and one Chai sachet), and Heldi pays the postage. Everyone on the list gets 15% off their first order. Terms: https://heldi.co.uk/legal/terms#waitlist-offer
- Contact and orders: via the waitlist at https://heldi.co.uk/#join until launch.
